# Welcome to my GSoC 2026 Journey

Follow my journey through Google Summer of Code 2026, where I, **Gaurav Chaudhary** (GitHub: **ANAMASGARD**), will share weekly updates, progress reports, and insights into the Animint2 project I'm passionate about. This blog documents my growth, challenges, and achievements throughout this incredible opportunity.

::: {.hero-actions}
[OPEN JOURNAL](/journal/){.journal-button .journal-button-primary}
:::
:::

## About the project

::: {.editorial-panel}
Animint2 extends the grammar of graphics with animated, linked, interactive visualizations for the web. This Quarto site is structured to document the work without inventing contributions: only verified outcomes, links, and project details will replace the starter entries.
:::
